X.note: The scene is flat, low-poly and grey-blue, with muddy lighting and no clear focal point. Foreground crates block the frame and a blank screen sits on the right. The 'toll' idea has no visual representation: there is no gate, booth, price or number. The caption is thin grey text sitting on dark blue crates, so contrast is mediocre. It is readable but low-impact and has no shadow or backing.

Y.note: There is a strong focal point: a glowing ladle pouring molten steel into a vessel, with sparks and bloom. The warm and cool contrast works and a human silhouette gives scale. The geometry is simple and the light shafts look slightly artificial, but it reads as a cinematic steel mill. It has no text, so it carries no number, place or policy context.

why: Y has a clear focal subject, dramatic lighting and an instantly recognisable steel-making moment, while X is a flat, cluttered scene that doesn't show what it claims to show.
top_fix_for_weaker: Rebuild X around one readable hero object, for example a toll gate or booth with a large lit price sign, such as '+25%', placed in the clear mid-frame. Move the crates out of the foreground. Add rim lighting and a dark gradient or pill behind a larger, bolder caption.
